The left base angle of this small triangle is marked as 25°, and what is sought at the vertex is angle 3. Reasoning: Because 51° is the exterior angle of the small left triangle at that base point, and together with the interior angle of the triangle forms a straight line, the interior angle there is 180° - 51° = 129°.
